title: Write the Cleanup Headline
tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

judge.summary: A polished square graphic pairs a catchy, readable headline with a friendly illustration of people collecting litter on a beach.

must_haves.item: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
must_haves.why: One complete square graphic is visible.

must_haves.item: A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
must_haves.why: The large headline reads “Happy Beach, Happy Planet,” supported by the clear call to action “Pitch in. Pick up. Make waves.”

must_haves.item: The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
must_haves.why: The headline is prominently integrated into the upper portion of the graphic.

must_haves.item: The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
must_haves.why: Three smiling people use litter pickers and collection bags on a sandy beach beside the ocean.

must_haves.item: No dates or signup details appear.
must_haves.why: No dates, registration information, or signup details are visible.
